### The Kinsman-Redeemer
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-november-1-2024.html
Passage: Ruth 3:9
Points:
- Israelite law provided the kinsman-redeemer to protect and restore impoverished relatives.
- Boaz willingly assumed this duty, extending shelter and care to vulnerable Naomi and Ruth.
- Boaz’s merciful actions foreshadow Jesus Christ as our ultimate Kinsman-Redeemer.
- Believers approach Christ in spiritual poverty and are welcomed under His protective wings.
- Christians can find rest and assurance knowing Jesus faithfully secures their eternal redemption.

### A Worthy Wife to Be: Tracing the Rare Beauty of Ruth
Author: Marshall Segal
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/a-worthy-wife-to-be
Passage: Ruth 3:11
Points:
- Ruth’s vulnerable nighttime initiative was motivated by purity, honor, and covenant love.
- Her reputation as a worthy woman sprang from sacrificial loyalty and steadfast courage.
- Ruth displayed persistent, hard-working devotion rather than self-protective independence.
- Her bold step shows how godly initiative can humbly invite a man’s pursuit.

### Ruth Asks Boaz to Redeem Her
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ruth-asks-boaz-to-redeem-her
Passage: Ruth 3:8-9
Points:
- Waiting on the Lord does not call believers to passive inactivity.
- Ruth boldly asked Boaz to spread his garment to redeem Naomi's family line.
- By making her appeal, Ruth invited Boaz to become the answer to his own blessing over her.
- Believers who pray for others should be prepared to serve as instruments of God's provision.
